_doc: Hand placements of semantics/tools/trace_requirements.py (basis explicit), read from each statement's text, Notes and Source. Placed: every I statement and every P statement the rules and finding bases leave without a target, when an axiom, contract clause, domain clause or functional clause of its module covers it. Principle for premises (kind P): an IRIS engine, driver or third-party fact is traced only to an iris-contract clause that decides it; one outside the validated contract subset stays open (a contract coverage gap, CONTRACT.md 'Outside the semantic subset'), with its reason in open_reasons. A premise that is a product or operator obligation supporting an axiom (callers send the fingerprint, an operator fronts the server with TLS) is traced to that axiom. Requirements left open on purpose are listed in open_reasons with the reason.

GID-I5.2.why: storage layout compatibility across releases: with the mode off the pre-mode layout is kept, so code of either release reads it (version gate)

WRT-I5.9.why: the indexes derived from val's text stay equal to their derivation when the text is unchanged

ADJ-I1.1.why: the out and in halves of the adjacency index are two derived copies of one row, kept equal and written together

ADJ-I3.4.1.why: representation rule of the multigraph layout (a single-edge triple is stored as a plain edge): a functional invariant of module 04
